purpose: Generate or import coordinated profile artwork and maintain verifiable, restorable releases in a consumer checkout.
inputs: optional six GIF and PNG files
adapters_own: read-only GitHub profile rendering and hosted byte verification
admission: Python 3.10+ and Pillow; edits scoped to the explicitly selected checkout; Git credentials stay with the operator.
proof_ceiling: Isolated consumer generation, exact V11 media import, local restore, and synthetic GitHub readback. Provider publication requires the consumer's ordinary authorized push and live verification.
